items_flat.title_en: OpenAI models and Codex coming to Google Cloud Model Garden
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI模型與Codex即將進入Google Cloud Model Garden
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced a partnership with Google Cloud to bring its frontier models, including GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT-6 Luna, plus Codex agentic workflows into Google Cloud’s Model Garden. Customers can purchase via Google Cloud Marketplace and apply existing spend commitments; general availability is planned in the coming weeks, with Microsoft remaining the primary cloud partner.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI宣布與Google Cloud合作，將其前沿模型（包括GPT-6 Astra、GPT-6.1 Sol與GPT-6 Luna）及Codex代理工作流程帶入Google Cloud的Model Garden。客戶可透過Google Cloud Marketplace購買並使用既有消費承諾；一般可用性計劃在未來數週推出，微軟仍為主要雲端合作夥伴。
items_flat.analysis_en: This expands OpenAI’s enterprise distribution beyond Microsoft and AWS to all three major US hyperscalers, reducing lock-in for customers while creating complex competitive dynamics with Google. Uncertainty remains around exact GA timing, pricing parity, and data governance in regulated industries.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這將OpenAI的企業分發從微軟與AWS擴展至美國三大超大規模雲端供應商，降低客戶鎖定，同時與Google形成複雜競爭動態。一般可用性時程、價格對等及受監管產業的資料治理仍不確定。
items_flat.quote: This partnership is an important step in making our most capable models and Codex available where customers are already building, giving them even more choice in how they use frontier AI.
items_flat.quote_zh: 這項合作是讓我們最強大模型與Codex在客戶已在建構的環境中可用的重要一步，讓他們在使用前沿AI時有更多選擇。

items_flat.title_en: Thousands of GPT-Rosalind agents analyze brain CRISPR data in 32 minutes
items_flat.title_zh: 數千GPT-Rosalind代理在32分鐘內分析大腦CRISPR數據
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI, PerturbAI and Scripps Research used thousands of distributed AI agents powered by GPT-Rosalind to analyze a whole-brain CRISPR atlas of millions of mouse brain cells in 32 minutes. The agents linked gene disruptions to literature and surfaced leads related to neurodegenerative disease, with human experts preferring the distributed approach.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI、PerturbAI與Scripps Research使用由GPT-Rosalind驅動的數千分散式AI代理，在32分鐘內分析數百萬小鼠腦細胞的全腦CRISPR圖譜。代理將基因破壞連結至文獻，並浮現與神經退化疾病相關的線索，人類專家偏好分散式方法。
items_flat.analysis_en: This demonstrates practical multi-agent scientific reasoning at scale on real biological datasets, compressing months of analysis. Follow-up experimental validation of the novel hypotheses remains the key open question for real-world impact.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這展示了在真實生物數據集上大規模實用多代理科學推理，將數月分析壓縮。對新假設的後續實驗驗證仍是現實影響的關鍵未解問題。
items_flat.quote: Working together, OpenAI, PerturbAI, and Scripps Research used thousands of AI agents powered by GPT‑Rosalind to analyze and interpret existing experimental data from millions of mouse brain cells in just 32 minutes.
items_flat.quote_zh: OpenAI、PerturbAI與Scripps Research合作，使用由GPT‑Rosalind驅動的數千AI代理，在短短32分鐘內分析並詮釋來自數百萬小鼠腦細胞的既有實驗數據。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI leads coordinated disclosure of critical PHP vulnerabilities found with models
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI主導以模型發現的關鍵PHP漏洞協調披露
items_flat.summary_en: As part of its Patch the Planet initiative, OpenAI coordinated a two-month response with maintainers, researchers and providers to critical PHP vulnerabilities (including one discovered using GPT-5.6 Sol). The flaws affect a widely used language powering an estimated 70% of websites; patches and guidance are now available.
items_flat.summary_zh: 作為Patch the Planet計畫的一部分，OpenAI與維護者、研究人員與供應商協調兩個月回應關鍵PHP漏洞（包括使用GPT-5.6 Sol發現的一個）。這些缺陷影響估計運行70%網站的廣泛使用語言；補丁與指引現已可用。
items_flat.analysis_en: It shows frontier models contributing to high-impact open-source security at internet scale, with defenders getting a window ahead of attackers. The early leak and intricate engine changes highlight coordination challenges for future AI-assisted disclosures.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這顯示前沿模型對網路規模高影響開源安全的貢獻，防禦者獲得領先攻擊者的窗口。早期洩漏與複雜引擎變更凸顯未來AI輔助披露的協調挑戰。
items_flat.quote: OpenAI models helped researchers—operating as part of our Patch the Planet initiative—discover critical security flaws in PHP, an open-source programming language used to run an estimated 70% of websites.
items_flat.quote_zh: OpenAI模型協助研究人員——作為我們Patch the Planet計畫的一部分——發現PHP中的關鍵安全缺陷，這是估計運行70%網站的開源程式語言。

items_flat.title_en: ChatGPT Ads expands to 26 new countries, reaching 89 total
items_flat.title_zh: ChatGPT廣告擴展至26個新國家，總計89國
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI expanded ChatGPT Ads to 26 additional countries (including more of Latin America, Europe, Africa and Asia), bringing total availability to 89 countries. Over 100,000 advertisers have run campaigns since launch; ads appear only on Free and Go plans, while Plus, Pro and Enterprise remain ad-free.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI將ChatGPT廣告擴展至26個額外國家（包括更多拉丁美洲、歐洲、非洲與亞洲地區），總可用性達89國。自推出以來已有超過10萬廣告主運行活動；廣告僅出現在免費與Go方案，Plus、Pro與Enterprise保持無廣告。
items_flat.analysis_en: The expansion accelerates monetization of free users to support broader access, with a reported path toward $1B annualized ad revenue. It tests user trust as conversational ads scale globally, while keeping paid tiers clean.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此擴展加速免費用戶變現以支持更廣泛存取，並有朝向年化10億美元廣告收入的路徑。隨著對話式廣告全球擴展，將測試用戶信任，同時保持付費方案純淨。
items_flat.quote: Since we launched ads just over eight months ago, over 100,000 advertisers have run campaigns on ChatGPT. Today, we’re expanding ChatGPT Ads to 26 additional countries, extending availability to 89 countries worldwide.
items_flat.quote_zh: 自約八個月前推出廣告以來，已有超過10萬廣告主在ChatGPT運行活動。今天，我們將ChatGPT廣告擴展至26個額外國家，將可用性延伸至全球89國。

items_flat.title_en: Mistral and NVIDIA collaborate on AI-native industrial engineering workflows
items_flat.title_zh: Mistral與NVIDIA合作開發AI原生工業工程工作流程
items_flat.summary_en: Mistral announced a collaboration with NVIDIA to integrate Mistral Large 4 and physics AI capabilities with NVIDIA accelerated computing, CUDA-X, Warp and Omniverse. The work will produce public benchmarks and open datasets for physics models and agentic AI in CAE and EDA, targeting aerospace, automotive and semiconductor applications.
items_flat.summary_zh: Mistral宣布與NVIDIA合作，將Mistral Large 4與物理AI能力整合至NVIDIA加速運算、CUDA-X、Warp與Omniverse。此工作將產出物理模型與CAE/EDA代理AI的公開基準與開放數據集，針對航太、汽車與半導體應用。
items_flat.analysis_en: This pairs Europe’s leading open-weight frontier model with NVIDIA’s simulation stack to target domain-specific agentic workflows, potentially standardizing evaluations that general leaderboards miss. Impact depends on the quality and adoption of the forthcoming benchmarks.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這將歐洲領先開放權重前沿模型與NVIDIA模擬堆疊配對，針對領域特定代理工作流程，可能標準化一般排行榜遺漏的評估。影響取決於即將推出的基準品質與採用程度。
items_flat.quote: With Mistral's open-weight models and physics AI capabilities, combined with NVIDIA’s accelerated computing stack, we’re giving engineers faster simulation cycles, as well as open benchmarks rigorous enough to validate agents on real CAE and EDA work.
items_flat.quote_zh: 結合Mistral的開放權重模型與物理AI能力，以及NVIDIA的加速運算堆疊，我們正為工程師提供更快的模擬週期，以及足以在真實CAE與EDA工作上驗證代理的嚴格開放基準。
